subject.title: feat(feishu): pass through form_value, input_value, option(s) from card actions

question: What should the Feishu card-action payload contract be when a callback has both command/envelope data and raw form/select fields?
rationale: The branch chooses JSON synthetic message text for form/select callbacks, but current Feishu card actions also have established command and structured-envelope paths, so the permanent payload contract affects compatibility and message delivery.

options.title: Preserve command routing plus metadata
options.body: Rebase the PR and pass the raw fields through the parser while keeping command/envelope dispatch as the default path, with metadata attached in a documented form.

options.title: Adopt JSON message payloads
options.body: Accept JSON text as the new form/select callback contract only after adding docs, compatibility notes, parser coverage, and live Feishu proof.

options.title: Leave this to the canonical issue
options.body: Close or pause this stale branch and keep the remaining design work on the linked Feishu issue until a fresh implementation is ready.

recommendation.title: Preserve command routing plus metadata
recommendation.body: Rebase the PR and pass the raw fields through the parser while keeping command/envelope dispatch as the default path, with metadata attached in a documented form.

likelyOwner.reason: Tak introduced the structured Feishu card-action contract that this decision would extend or bypass.
